not_liked_ids=[310,31,173,247,12,304,202]
existing_review_ids={247:294,12:295}
updated=[]
created=[]
# update existing reviews to 1
for sid, rid in existing_review_ids.items():
    print('updating song',sid,'review',rid,'to rating 1')
    resp=apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=rid, access_token=access_token, rating=1)
    print('update resp',resp)
    updated.append(sid)
# create reviews for remaining songs
for sid in not_liked_ids:
    if sid in existing_review_ids:
        continue
    print('creating review for song',sid,'rating 1')
    resp=apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=sid, rating=1, access_token=access_token, title='', text='')
    print('create resp',resp)
    created.append(sid)
print('updated_count',len(updated),'created_count',len(created))
print('updated_songs',updated)
print('created_songs',created)
